items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Buck Lee Young out on the road and you took them home.

ctx.x: You were talking about those guys--Buck Lee Young out on the road and you took them home. It wasn't too chic, bringing black cats home with you in those days. I know we had a kind of tough time sometimes.
Oh, yeah. Well, the town I came from was basically a Southern town. It was mostly Anglo-Saxon Protestants from Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas and that area,
